model_not_configured: model provider {provider} is not configured, missing configuration parameters: {parameters}
anthropic_model_provider_description: Note: Anthropic does not have an embeddings model and [recommends](https://docs.anthropic.com/en/docs/build-with-claude/embeddings) Voyage AI.
deepseek_model_provider_api_key_descript: DeepSeek API Key. Can be created and fetched from https://platform.deepseek.com/api_keys
generic_openai_model_provider_descriptio: Model Provider for generic [OpenAI API compatible](https://platform.openai.com/docs/api-reference/introduction) model providers, like LM-Studio, Ollama, vLLM, etc.
generic_openai_model_provider_base_url_d: Base URL for the OpenAI-compatible API, e.g. http://localhost:1234/v1 for LM-Studio.
generic_openai_model_provider_api_key_de: API Key for the OpenAI-compatible API. Some providers like Ollama don't enforce Authentication, so this is optional.
generic_responses_model_provider_descrip: Model Provider for generic [Responses API compatible](https://www.openresponses.org) model providers, like [Ollama](https://ollama.com/) (`http://127.0.0.1:11434/v1`), LiteLLM, etc.
generic_responses_model_provider_base_ur: Base URL for the OpenAI Responses-compatible API (e.g. http://127.0.0.1:11434/v1 for Ollama).
generic_responses_model_provider_api_key: API Key for the OpenAI Responses-compatible API. Some providers like Ollama don't enforce Authentication, so this is optional.
groq_model_provider_description: Model provider for models running on Groq
groq_model_provider_api_key_description: Groq API Key. Can be created and fetched from https://console.groq.com/keys
ollama_model_provider_description: Model provider for models running on Ollama
openai_model_provider_api_key_descriptio: OpenAI API Key. Can be created and fetched from https://platform.openai.com/settings/organization/api-keys or https://platform.openai.com/api-keys
vllm_model_provider_endpoint_description: Endpoint for the vLLM OpenAI service (eg. http://localhost:8000)
vllm_model_provider_api_key_description: VLLM API Key set when starting the vLLM server
amazon_bedrock_api_key_model_provider_de: Model provider for Amazon Bedrock models using API key authentication
amazon_bedrock_api_key_model_provider_re: AWS Region for Amazon Bedrock (defaults to us-east-1)
amazon_bedrock_model_provider_descriptio: Model provider for Amazon Bedrock models
amazon_bedrock_model_provider_session_to: AWS Session Token for temporary credentials
amazon_bedrock_model_provider_region_des: AWS Region for Amazon Bedrock, defaults to us-east-1
azure_entra_model_provider_description: Model provider for Azure OpenAI/Foundry models using Entra ID service principal authentication
azure_entra_model_provider_endpoint_desc: Azure service endpoint URL (e.g. https://my-resource.cognitiveservices.azure.com/ or https://my-resource.openai.azure.com/)
azure_entra_model_provider_resource_grou: Azure resource group containing the Cognitive Services account
azure_model_provider_description: Model provider for Azure OpenAI/Foundry models using API key authentication
azure_model_provider_endpoint_descriptio: Azure service endpoint URL (e.g. https://my-resource.cognitiveservices.azure.com/ or https://my-resource.openai.azure.com/)
azure_model_provider_deployments_descrip: List of deployments (format: deployment[:usage[:dialect]]). Usage defaults to 'llm' and supports 'llm', 'reasoning-llm', 'text-embedding', or 'image-generation'. Dialect defaults to OpenAI and supports 'openai' or 'anthropic'.
gemini_vertex_model_provider_name: Google Gemini Vertex AI Model Provider
gemini_vertex_model_provider_description: Model provider for Google Gemini Vertex AI
gemini_vertex_model_provider_google_cred: Google Cloud Account Credentials - JSON File Contents: https://cloud.google.com/iam/docs/keys-create-delete#creating
